parole.testo: Ultimately from Persian قبا (qabâ, qabâ, “coat”), via Byzantine Greek καβάδης (kabádēs) (whence also dialectal Bulgarian кавад (kavad), Serbo-Croatian кавад/kavad). Compare Russian кабат (kabat), Belarusian кабат (kabat) and Ukrainian кабат (kabat).

parole.significato: the words spoken at the end of a chess game by the winner, checkmate
parole.testo: Derived from Persian شاه مات (šâh mât, “the king is dead”).
